exo01/buoyancy.py.name: The shapes in the water
exo01/buoyancy.py.description: Describes each float as a closed 3D shape, cuts it at the water surface and measures exactly how much of it is submerged, at any angle.

exo01/equilibrium.py.name: Where it comes to rest
exo01/equilibrium.py.description: Finds the depth, the lean and the nose-up angle at which weight and buoyancy balance, then reports the freeboard left at every point of interest.

exo01/mass.py.name: Weight and balance
exo01/mass.py.description: Adds up every item on board into a total weight and balance point; if a weight or a position is unknown it stops rather than guessing.
